name: POST-BLIND FEW-SHOT RECOVERY
runs_only_after: both PRIMARY and SECONDARY blind scores and hashes are frozen

split.rule: SHA256("NI" | composition_id | "20260912"), ascending; lowest 30% (= 600 compositions) -> FEWSHOT_CALIBRATION, remaining 1400 -> RECOVERY_EVALUATION

evaluation_note: RECOVERY_EVALUATION labels were part of initial blind scoring; this is a post-blind recovery evaluation subset.
random_rationale: STEP5E found maximin worse than random at 1-8 shots.
sequence_seed_rule: sha256(20260912|FEWSHOT_SEQ_<replicate>), first four bytes big-endian; numpy default_rng permutation of sorted calibration IDs
budget_rule: first b composition IDs of each 32-composition sequence; all 11 temperatures grouped

anchor_selection_secondary.geometry: At STEP5H-A, use frozen PRIMARY scaler and 43 inputs. Flatten 11 standardized rows per composition in temperature order into 473 coordinates. Euclidean distance. Reference only original PRIMARY train compositions with all 11 input rows available.
anchor_selection_secondary.selection: First calibration composition maximizes nearest distance to PRIMARY training compositions. Subsequently maximize minimum distance to training and selected compositions. Lexicographically smallest composition_id breaks exact ties. One nested sequence of 32.
anchor_selection_secondary.execution: Defer geometry until Ni inputs are available; freeze selected IDs before Ni CALPHAD.

refit.data: exact PRIMARY original train IDs plus selected Ni calibration compositions; no recovery-eval labels used for fitting or stopping
refit.artifact_policy: new post-blind recovery checkpoint, never overwrite or replace either frozen zero-shot checkpoint
refit.initialization: fresh PRIMARY architecture from PRIMARY production child seed; do not carry weights from another budget
refit.validation: exact original-six PRIMARY DEV_VALIDATION IDs; early stopping on raw MSE; no Ni validation or LR search
refit.scaler: frozen PRIMARY scaler; never refit scaler on Ni
refit.projection: clip negatives, renormalize; zero-sum uses frozen PRIMARY training-mean simplex
refit.scope_resolution: Sections 30/58 protect zero-shot artifacts; sections 68/69 permit only separately named post-blind recovery weight refits.

secondary_controls.R0_ANCHOR_TRIVIAL_PER_T: Ignore the model. For each temperature T, predict the mean true X-partition simplex of the k anchor compositions at that same T. This is the control: if R2 does not beat R0, no improvement beyond the anchors is demonstrated by R2 under this protocol.
secondary_controls.R1_GLOBAL_MEAN_SHIFT: delta = mean over all k*11 anchor states of (true - raw model output); corrected = project_simplex(raw + delta). One 5-vector for the whole set.
secondary_controls.R2_PER_TEMPERATURE_MEAN_SHIFT: delta_T = mean over the k anchor states at temperature T of (true - raw model output); corrected = project_simplex(raw + delta_T). Eleven 5-vectors; exactly k anchor states feed each, so it is defined for every budget including k=1.

control_interpretation: Report paired TVD difference versus R0. Failure to outperform R0 means no demonstrated improvement beyond anchors under this protocol; do not infer universal absence of model information.
evaluation: same converged RECOVERY_EVALUATION rows for all methods and budgets; report each replicate plus mean and spread
B_skill: smallest budget with mean TVD across three random replicates below PRIMARY training-mean trivial on the same subset; >32 if none
B_recovery25: smallest budget whose across-replicate mean TVD is reduced >=25% vs PRIMARY zero-shot on same subset; >32 if none
anchor_failure_policy: Do not replace selected compositions. Use converged anchor states only; report effective states per temperature. If no anchor exists at a temperature, mean-shift controls use zero shift and R0 uses frozen PRIMARY trivial. No fabricated labels.

optional_low_order_anchor_study.comparison: quaternary direct Ni anchors vs Cu-Ni / Cr-Ni / Nb-Ni low-order anchors
optional_low_order_anchor_study.requirements: separate user authorization after zero-shot scores; clean uniformly defined CALPHAD protocol
optional_low_order_anchor_study.name: THERMODYNAMICALLY ANCHORED FEW-SHOT / LOW-ORDER TRANSFER
